name: audiophonics_evo_sabre
description: The EVO Sabre's second display and its remote control
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Drives the EVO Sabre's second OLED display (the track, its format, the time played, a clock while the player rests) and the transport keys of its remote control. One small program does both; nothing is compiled on the player and no remote-control daemon is installed.
volumio_info.changelog: 2.99.3 A build of what will be version 3, for the bench. Click prevention now plays on a player with multiroom in its audio path, and switching it no longer moves the volume. Updating over version 2 no longer leaves the display dark until the player restarts. Click prevention is a switch that holds the audio output open so the DAC's clocks never stop between tracks. The display and the remote are one small native program: no Node add-on to rebuild when Volumio moves, no lirc.
